_: Per-phase HEADTRACK / FACING control on a SCEN scene. Same two-NPC tavern conversation, but each phase now steers where the speaker looks: by default they face EACH OTHER (headtrackActor omitted = -2), one phase turns to the PLAYER (headtrackPlayer:true — e.g. an aside to you), and one phase looks at NO ONE (headtrackActor:-1, faceTarget:false — a brooding line staring off). headtrackActor: an actor aliasId = look at that actor; -1 = no one; omit (default) = the other actor. headtrackPlayer and a non-default headtrackActor are mutually exclusive. faceTarget (default true) sets the FaceTarget flag. Structural-only verified (validate+build). coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn after a save+reload.

quests._: Host quest for the scene. startGameEnabled (default) so the scene loads/plays.
quests.name: ModForge Scene Headtrack

phases._: default: Borin faces Hilda (the other actor)
lines: You still owe me for the ale, Hilda.

phases._: Hilda turns to YOU mid-argument, an aside to the player
lines: You hear this, traveler? The cheek of the man.

phases._: Borin stares off at no one, brooding (no headtrack, no facing)
lines: ...Maybe the ale was a touch sour.

phases._: default again: Hilda faces Borin to close it out
lines: Ha! Buy me a drink and we're even.
